info.name: Looker Auth Look API
info.description:
The Looker API 4.0 provides programmatic access to the Looker business intelligence platform. It allows you to manage and interact with Looks, dashboards, queries, users, and other Looker resources. The API uses client credentials (client_id and client_secret) for authentication and returns JSON responses. Looker is part of Google Cloud and the API is available on any Looker instance at the /api/4.0 path.

Contact Support:
 Name: Google Cloud Looker Support
